title: Approximate tangent planes of a set lying in an affine plane x + V are contained in V
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, A ⊆ Euclid P (= ℝ^P), x ∈ Euclid P, and let Q and V be linear subspaces of Euclid P. Assume a − x ∈ V for every a ∈ A. Assume also that Q is an approximate tangent space of A at x in the sense of HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q (Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.4, as formalized in SimonGMT Chapter03/Rectifiable.lean). This means: (a) finrank Q = n, and (b) for every compactly supported continuous f : Euclid P → ℝ, ∫_{η_{x,r}(A)} f dHⁿ → ∫_Q f dHⁿ as r → 0⁺ (along the filter 𝓝[>] 0). Here η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹ • (y − x) is blowUpMap x r, Hⁿ = μHE[n], each integral is taken against the restriction of Hⁿ to the indicated set, and no measurability of A is assumed. Then Q ⊆ V, i.e. Q ≤ V as submodules.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ a ∈ A, a - x ∈ V) → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q → Q ≤ V
